name: Neon DB Admin
description: Browser-based universal database workbench and visual ER diagram designer supporting SQLite (WASM), MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare D1, and LibSQL.
features: Data Grid with visual filter builder, sorting, inline editing, FK jump, and JSON cell inspector
Multi-tab SQL Editor with syntax highlighting, autocomplete, EXPLAIN plan, formatter, history, snippets, and SVG charts
MySQL Workbench-style Visual ER Diagram Designer with Crow's Foot notation, reverse engineering, forward DDL engineering, SVG/PNG/Mermaid/DBML export
Table Designer, Index & Foreign Key Manager, Cross-Dialect DDL Converter
Import/Export Suite: SQLite binary, SQL Dump, SQL script runner, auto-typed CSV/TSV/JSON import
Schema Health Audit, Schema Diff Migration Generator, Mock Data Generator
Offline-capable PWA with Light/Dark mode and Japanese/English UI
